description.value: Value on Liquor Store is an independent liquor retailer that has operated since 2012, marketing itself on prices that beat BC government liquor stores. It is notable for housing what it claims is BC's longest cooler, stocking a broad selection of cold beer, ciders, wine, spirits, and sake. Free on-site parking and a curbside pickup option make it a convenient stop for cyclists traveling along Southwest Marine Drive.

address.value: 1450 SW Marine Drive, Vancouver, BC V6P 5Z9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms Value on Liquor Store is an open, operating retail liquor shop at 1450 SW Marine Drive since 2012. The phone number (604-558-2583) matches OSM exactly; however, OSM lists house number 1460 while the website consistently shows 1450 — a discrepancy flagged in concerns. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike rack, washrooms, water, Wi-Fi) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags; curbside pickup is confirmed via the FAQ page as an explicit online-order pickup service.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists house number 1460 but the website consistently shows 1450 SW Marine Drive. The OSM address may be incorrect; website value used in the address field.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible liquor retailer operating since 2012 with a functioning website and confirmed phone number. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking beverages.
